$comment: Manifest row for the `ever-works/missions` catalog (added 2026-09-17 — EXT-13; reshaped by APW-08 T41 to the live `manifest.json` row: slug, title, summary, type, schedule, tags, missionPath, briefPath, readmePath). Add this object, without `$comment` and `runtimeRepository`, to the catalog's manifest.json. The catalog's own schema requires slug, title, type, summary and schedule; it rejects `version`, `defaults`, `kb`, `appWork` and `suggestedGoals`, which is why the runtime manifest stays in the standalone seed repository named in `runtimeRepository` and this row only describes the listing.
title: Build on an open-source app
summary: Build my own product for my business on top of an open-source app I already run: every Monday it files up to two small, budgeted, approval-gated changes on an App Work and follows each one until it is live.
